Laura / Tom — thanks for the clear asks. I pulled together a proposed MAP and commercial tie-ins below. I'm including Monica (CS) and Marissa (Sales Lead) to confirm discount thresholds.

High-level proposed MAP (milestones & dates)
- Week 0 (pilot start): Hand-off + access provisioning, evaluation prompts + baseline metrics collection (1 week prep)
- Weeks 1–4 (pilot): Production pilot on sandbox tenant, focus on latency SLA and cost-per-1k tokens metrics
- Week 5 (review): Pilot review, quality sign-off, compliance checklist (SOC2 evidence upload, audit logging validation)
- Week 6–8 (contracting): Negotiate final SOW and billing cadence, DocuSign signature
- Q3 (ramp): Commit go-live — committed annual spend triggers discounts & Audit Add-on pricing as agreed

Commercial anchors tied to MAP milestones
- Pilot completion (sign-off): no charge for pilot infrastructure beyond usage; Redwood provides up to $10k in credits for pilot overages
- Contract signature (DocuSign): 10% standard onboarding credit applied to first invoice if signed within 3 business days of SOW
- Commit threshold: 12-month commit >= $480k ARR -> unlocks 18% volume discount on baseline inference pricing + waived setup fee for Dedicated
- Ramp schedule: if usage reaches 50% of committed throughput within first 90 days, additional 3% discount applied retroactively

Compliance / Security add-on pricing (draft)
- Audit logs (base): 90-day retention, included
- Audit logs (12-month retention, exportable parquet): $2,250/month (covers storage + guaranteed export delivery SLA)
- Premium Controls bundle (RBAC, SSO, extended audit surface, audit log streaming to customer's S3): $3,500/month
- SOC2 evidence pack (one-time evidence collection & collection support): $6,500 (one-time)
- Enterprise KMS integration & HSM support: quote-based (typ. $8–15k one-time + $500/mo monitoring)

Discount policy notes: we can offer the audit-log 12-month retention at 50% off for the first 6 months if Fintera signs a >= $600k ARR commit and agrees to the ramp schedule above. That would make the audit add-on $1,125/mo for the first 6 months.

Attachments I'm sharing: "Fintera_MAP_v2.xlsx" (MAP with milestone dates), "redwood-compliance-add-on-pricing.pdf" (line-item pricing).

Next steps I'd propose:
1) Laura: confirm pilot start date (Earliest: Mon May 4)
2) Tom / procurement: confirm whether Fintera can include a roll-forward clause for logs export in the SOW
3) Monica: I'll schedule a short sync to validate the audit log export flow and SSO mapping (30 min)

If everyone is good, I can submit the commercial sheet for Marissa to approve the discount pathway.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Trigger: Fintera can request ad-hoc exports via the Console; for audit-triggered exports, we provide an "Export Request" runbook and support from our Compliance team
- Delivery SLA: standard export within 5 business days for full 12-month export (we will ship to a pre-configured S3 bucket and provide a signed delivery manifest)

Pricing concession (finalized offer if they sign >= $480k ARR before May 15)
- Audit add-on: $1,200/month for first 6 months, then $1,850/month thereafter (annualized commitment reflected in SOW)
- Premium Controls bundle: $3,250/month (first 6 months 20% off) if they take Dedicated for 12 months
- SOC2 evidence pack: still $6,500 one-time

Pilot start: we can commit to pilot start on May 25 if SOW is executed by May 14 (operations window to provision tenant + SSO mapping).

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet with these numbers and push to the HubSpot record. If Tom / procurement are good, please confirm and I'll get a DocuSign SOW with the pricing lines and the commit clause.
